slides.title: Can You Map Your Attack Surface?
slides.subtitle: Most candidates have never tried

bullets: Run nmap on your home lab - know every open port
Use Shodan to see what's exposed online
Document what talks to what - draw the diagram
Add it to your portfolio - it gets noticed

caption: Theory gets you to the interview. Proof gets you the job. Map something real, document it, and watch how differently hiring managers treat you. #cybersecurity #cybersecuritycareers #ethicalhacking #cypherjobs #infosec
